main: Got half a cabbage left in the fridge? Don't let it go to waste! This Osaka-style okonomiyaki is the perfect way to use it all up. It's surprisingly light and packed with sweet cabbage flavor, making it a delicious and satisfying meal that feels like a mini-vacation at home.
reply1:
For one pancake:
• 1/4 head cabbage, thinly shredded
• 4 tbsp oat flour (or Korean pancake mix)
• 4 tbsp water
• 1 egg
• 1 pinch salt
• Okonomi sauce, mayonnaise, bonito flakes (katsuobushi) for topping
reply2: Mix batter ingredients, then fold in cabbage until just coated. Cook on low heat, covered, for 5 minutes per side. Flip boldly! Top with sauce, mayo, and bonito flakes.
alt_text: A Japanese okonomiyaki cabbage pancake on a plate, topped with okonomi sauce, a mayonnaise zigzag, and dancing bonito flakes, in a home kitchen with warm, appetizing light.
